description.en: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI: fork a new session from a chosen turn, interrupt generation, copy the working directory path or session ID, open the working directory, and export session logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话轮次上点击右键弹出的圆盘菜单：从此轮分叉出新会话、打断生成、复制工作目录路径与会话 ID、打开工作目录、导出会话日志。
